violations.text: Raw animal foods (eggs, chicken, beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (cooked chicken, beverages) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. Sanitizer bay was set-up during inspection. Staff instructed to sanitized all equipment that was washed earlier. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (prep unit cutting boards, underside and slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

Per interview of staff, prep unit cutting boards sanitized at the end of the day. The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

deli meats were observed held at 53 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. It was determined that the unit was open for an extended period of time while stocking with product. Deli meats out of temperature were brought to the walk-in to rapidly chill. Options discussed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

Multiple foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026

Working containers of dressings and oils are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026

The concentration of the chlorine sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for chlorine sanitizer is 50-100 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026
The following were observed in poor repair: -refrigerator door gaskets on several units -display case (condensation dripping). New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (slicer, display case, refrigerator gaskets) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026
A leak was observed at the bidet attachment to the toilet. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026
Several floor tiles in kitchen and walk-in were observed cracked, loose, or missing. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026

The floors under and behind equipment throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue, food debris, and old rodent droppings (basement). The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026
